query: What material change was recommended for the alternator mounting bracket in the FY23 teardown study?
answer_anchor: Cast-iron bracket replaced with HSLA steel; approximately 18 per cent weight reduction, no change in fatigue life.
notes: Baseline query carried over from the September development build, so results are comparable.

query: Has any competitor benchmark evaluated composite leaf springs for this vehicle segment?
answer_anchor: GFRP composite mono-leaf, 35 per cent mass saving against the steel multi-leaf, durability validation ongoing.
notes: Carried over from the development build. LABEL CORRECTED 28 October 2026, after the first evaluation run: was section 2, page 5; now section 2.1, page 6. Verified against the raw PDF page text, independently of retrieval: the 35 per cent mass saving and the open durability validation are on p.6 under 2.1.1 and 2.1.2; section 2 on p.5 only points forward to section 2.1.

query: What was the measured in-cab noise difference in the 2024 cabin benchmark?
answer_anchor: 63 dB(A) against 68 dB(A) at 80 km/h, attributed to the air-suspended cab mount and acoustic laminated glass.
notes: Deliberately phrased without naming any vehicle, since the corpus is anonymised.

query: What gearbox ratio spread was recorded in the powertrain and driveline benchmark?
answer_anchor: Nine-speed gearbox with a ratio spread of about 11.5:1 against the current platform's six-speed at about 6.8:1.

query: What wear-reduction change was identified for the tipper body in mining duty?
answer_anchor: Hardened-steel bolt-on floor liner, plus 42.0 kg, for the mining and quarry duty variant.

query: What cooling pack change was benchmarked for the construction-duty variant?
answer_anchor: Increased-margin radiator core, about 15 per cent larger frontal area, with an electronically controlled viscous fan.

query: How much can be saved by eliminating the separate quench and temper operation on the front axle beam?
answer_anchor: About INR 1,240 per beam by moving to a micro-alloyed grade cooled directly from forging heat.
notes: Finding 3.2. The largest single cost opportunity in that teardown. LABEL CORRECTED 28 October 2026, after the first evaluation run: was section 3.2, page 4; now section 3.2, page 5. Verified against the raw PDF page text, independently of retrieval: INR 1,240 per beam is on p.5, the second page of section 3.2; p.4 is where the section starts.

query: What proportion of VAVE ideas closed in FY24 H1 were duplicates?
answer_anchor: 148 of 337 closures, 43.9 per cent, were duplicates of ideas already on record.
notes: The headline statistic the whole project rests on.

query: How has the price of hot-rolled coil moved over the last twenty-four months?
answer_anchor: HR coil IS 2062 E250 fell 9.3 per cent, from INR 58.4 to INR 53.0 per kg.

query: Why did the aluminium cab mounting bracket crack in service?
answer_anchor: Fretting-initiated fatigue at the clamped interface between the aluminium mount face and the steel washer.
notes: The mechanism, not the symptom. Tests whether retrieval returns the cause.

query: What salt spray performance is required for a bracket directly exposed to road spray?
answer_anchor: Exposure class C1 requires 720 hours to red rust, tested to IS 9844.

query: At what annual volume does a progressive press tool become cheaper than fabrication for a chassis bracket?
answer_anchor: 21,400 units per year at single-programme volume.

query: How much of the FY27 kerb mass target is still unallocated?
answer_anchor: 61 kg of the 232 kg target remains unallocated; 171 kg is committed.

query: Why was the proposal to delete the roof acoustic pad withdrawn?
answer_anchor: Deleting it would cost about 2.1 dB(A) at 1 kHz, exceeding the available margin against the cabin noise target.
notes: In meeting-minutes register, which shares little vocabulary with the query. LABEL CORRECTED 28 October 2026, after the first evaluation run: was section 5.1, page 5; now section 5, page 5. Verified against the raw PDF page text, independently of retrieval: the document has no section 5.1; 'Outcome 5.1' is a numbered outcome callout inside section 5 (NVH package discussion), not a section number.

query: Why was the aluminium cab mounting bracket reversed, and under what conditions could it be proposed again?
answer_anchor: Mechanism: fretting-initiated fatigue at the clamped interface. Five stated conditions, including a fixture that reproduces the joint and validation on the tipper duty cycle.
notes: Two distant sections of one document. Tests whether retrieval returns both, not just the first.

query: If I propose an aluminium bracket bolted to a steel frame, what validation does the standard require?
answer_anchor: A fixture reproducing the clamped joint in dissimilar materials; a component-level result on a rigid interface plate is not acceptable evidence.
notes: The standard states the requirement; the warranty report explains why it exists.

query: Should the front spring bracket move from fabrication to pressing?
answer_anchor: Break-even is 21,400 units against a platform volume of 18,000, so not at single-programme volume; combined volume is 29,400, which reverses the answer.
notes: The answer is conditional and the condition lives in a different section from the number.

query: Is the PET felt headliner idea at risk?
answer_anchor: Field Quality raised hot-climate sag history at the workshop; the roadmap lists VC-24-0502 as at risk with 3.40 kg exposed.
notes: Requires a meeting minute and a programme roadmap - very different registers. query: What coating should I specify for an exposed chassis bracket, and what does it cost?
answer_anchor: Zinc-nickel 8 um, zinc flake or E-coat plus topcoat meet the 720 hour C1 requirement; zinc-nickel is INR 412 per square metre.
notes: Requirement in one document, rate in another.

query: Why were two frame web reduction ideas assessed differently when they look almost identical?
answer_anchor: VC-24-0124 and VC-24-0129 differ only by a local doubler; the first failed hanger fatigue and the second passed at 1.18 times target.
notes: The distinguishing feature is a single design element.

query: Which closed ideas would now qualify at current material rates?
answer_anchor: Eleven of nineteen threshold closures would now qualify; the cost index lists the specific ideas that crossed.

query: What is the largest cost gap in the front axle group and does the supplier panel support fixing it?
answer_anchor: INR 4,680 total, 74 per cent in the beam and brake bracketry; forging capability exists on the panel with a 30 to 40 week tool lead time.

query: What change was made to the door check bracket?

query: What was decided about the front spring rear bracket?

query: Can I use a lock washer to stop the bolt coming loose?
answer_anchor: Separate lock washers are withdrawn; prevailing torque shall be achieved by the serrated flange of family F1.

query: My bracket keeps rusting through. What should I have specified?
answer_anchor: For exposure class C1, a system meeting 720 hours to red rust: zinc-nickel, zinc flake or E-coat plus topcoat.
notes: Symptom described informally; answer is a clause-numbered requirement table.

query: Do I need approval to use a fastener that is not on the list?
answer_anchor: A D2 deviation, approved by the Standards Committee, valid for a single part number for 36 months.

query: Why does my cost case keep getting rejected when the saving looks fine?
answer_anchor: Material substitution cases older than twelve months must be re-costed; estimates without a rate basis date cannot be re-tested.
